title: ASPCA Poison Control
publisher: American Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals
topic: suspected animal poisoning and toxic ingestion
geographicScope: ASPCA Poison Control is a United States service and a consultation fee may apply. PetPal users in India should immediately contact a local emergency veterinarian or animal hospital and should not assume a US phone service is locally accessible.
content:
A suspected poisoning should be treated as an urgent veterinary concern. Seek real-time advice from an emergency veterinarian or qualified animal poison professional rather than relying on an AI answer or waiting for symptoms to develop.

ASPCA Poison Control describes a 24-hour, year-round service staffed by veterinary toxicology professionals, and notes that a consultation fee may apply. This is a United States service; PetPal users in India should contact the nearest local emergency veterinarian or animal hospital for immediately actionable help.

The ASPCA resource organizes poison-prevention information about plants, human foods, human medications, household products, and seasonal hazards. The risk and next steps depend on the animal, substance, amount, and timing, so an individualized professional assessment is important.
